verdict.rationale: Anthropic maintains a first-party API release-notes page (platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/api.md). It records both model changes, such as the new flagship's 1M context window, 128k max output, and always-on adaptive thinking, and API changes, such as `GET /v1/models` now returning a `capabilities` object. A standing deprecations page with advance-notice retirement dates supports following model changes over time. Missing for 10: evidence of a subscription mechanism for following updates (RSS or email), and independent or community corroboration that the changelog is kept current.
